```{r}
#| label: workshop-flow
#| echo: false

library(DiagrammeR)

grViz("
digraph workshop_flow {
  graph [
    rankdir = LR
    fontname = 'Helvetica'
    bgcolor = 'transparent'
    nodesep = 0.6
    ranksep = 0.9
    margin = '0.2,0.1'
  ]

  node [
    fontname = 'Helvetica'
    style = 'filled,rounded'
    fontcolor = 'white'
    penwidth = 0
    shape = box
  ]

  edge [
    fontname = 'Helvetica'
    fontsize = 9
    color = '#b0b0b0'
    arrowsize = 0.7
  ]

  einstieg [
    label = 'Einstieg\n10 min'
    fillcolor = '#64748b'
    fontsize = 11
    margin = '0.2,0.15'
  ]

  teil1 [
    label = 'Teil 1\nLernen verstehen\n\nKognitive Architektur\nSchemas & Expertise\n\n50 min'
    fillcolor = '#0072B2'
    fontsize = 12
    margin = '0.25,0.18'
    width = 2.2
  ]

  pause [
    label = 'Pause\n15 min'
    fillcolor = '#e5e7eb'
    fontcolor = '#64748b'
    fontsize = 10
    margin = '0.15,0.12'
    style = 'filled'
    shape = ellipse
  ]

  teil2 [
    label = 'Teil 2\nKI & Lernen\n\nOffloading vs. Outsourcing\nEvaluationsparadox\n5-Fragen-Framework\n\n30 min'
    fillcolor = '#E69F00'
    fontcolor = '#222222'
    fontsize = 12
    margin = '0.25,0.18'
    width = 2.2
  ]

  teil3 [
    label = 'Teil 3\nPraxis\n\nAufgaben-Analyse\nPeer-Diagnose\n\n55 min'
    fillcolor = '#9A4665'
    fontsize = 12
    margin = '0.25,0.18'
    width = 2.2
  ]

  abschluss [
    label = 'Abschluss\n15 min'
    fillcolor = '#64748b'
    fontsize = 11
    margin = '0.2,0.15'
  ]

  einstieg -> teil1
  teil1 -> pause
  pause -> teil2 [label = '  Abrufpraxis  ']
  teil2 -> teil3
  teil3 -> abschluss
}
")
```
